mapper.select: SELECT ci.id as id, ci.quantity as quantity, p.product_image as productImage, p.name as productName, p.price as productPrice, p.id as productId, CASE WHEN pr.start_time <= NOW() AND pr.end_time >= NOW() THEN p.price - pr.discount_price ELSE p.price END AS productPriceAfterDiscount FROM cart_item ci INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = ci.product_id LEFT JOIN promotion pr ON pr.product_id = p.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId}
